natural-earth.dataset: Natural Earth vector data (land 1:50m, lakes 1:10m, rivers 1:10m + North America supplement)
natural-earth.citation: Made with Natural Earth. Free vector and raster map data @ naturalearthdata.com.
natural-earth.note: Not a federal dataset. Used only as a cartographic basemap; replace with USGS NHD/3DHP/WBD in a later milestone.
